text: My daily routine starts early. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and drink a glass of water before breakfast. After that, I get ready for work and leave home at eight. I work from nine to five, with a short lunch break at noon. In the afternoon, I often go to the gym or take a walk in the park. In the evening, I cook dinner and relax by reading or watching TV. I try to go to bed before eleven. Staying consistent helps me feel organized, healthy, and ready for each new day.
